subject: SIG-Lite: request for deploy chronology + credential rotation evidence
messages:
From: Mike Chen <mike.chen@auditops.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Cc: AuditOps SOC Team <soc@auditops.com>
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG-Lite: SDLC chronology + ephemeral credential rotation evidence

Hi Priya,

The NorthBridge assessor team is working through the SIG-Lite questionnaire and has a focused follow-up on our deploy/change chronology and ephemeral credential rotation controls for the inference runtime. They asked for a compact set of artifacts we can validate end-to-end:

- CI/CD run logs showing approvals and build hashes for the last 6 months (audit window)
- Pull request review exports tied to deploys (who approved, timestamps, PR numbers)
- Change approval / emergency patch justification entries and the corresponding runbook steps for rollback
- KMS/HSM rotation records or key version history for service credentials used by the VPC/private deployments
- Evidence that ephemeral CI tokens are scoped and rotated (sampling of token audit logs, redacted)

Can you produce a short manifest describing which files you will provide and an expected delivery ETA? The assessor prefers CSV manifests and object-level run logs, but redaction of secrets/cleartext tokens is required. I attached the SIG-lite follow-up PDF with the exact questionnaire rows to map to artifacts.

If you prefer to hand this to a technical owner, please loop them in and flag anything that needs extra time.

Thanks,
Mike Chen
AuditOps (on behalf of NorthBridge)

[Attachment: SIG-lite_questions_2026-08-30.pdf]

From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: Mike Chen <mike.chen@auditops.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG-Lite: SDLC chronology + ephemeral credential rotation evidence

Hi Mike — thanks for the clear ask and the attached questionnaire. 

Quick plan: Marissa will assemble the CI and PR artifacts and produce a mapping CSV; Irene will extract KMS rotation history and the runbook excerpts for emergency patch/rollback; I will create a short narrative that ties artifacts to the SIG rows and handle redaction. We can produce an initial manifest and sample artifacts by EOD PDT tomorrow (2026-08-31). Full package (including sampled token audit logs with redactions) by 2026-09-03.

Action items (owners):
- Marissa: export CI run logs (last 6 months), PR export per deploy, generate evidence_manifest_v1.csv
- Irene: export KMS key-version history and emergency-change runbook excerpts
- Priya: consolidate mapping, redact sensitive values, upload to shared Drive, and send final link to assessor

We will include attachment stubs in the manifest so you can request any additional logs. If the assessor needs a narrower sampling window, let us know.

Priya Natarajan
Senior Manager, Compliance Programs
Redwood Inference

[Forwarded attachment: SIG-lite_questions_2026-08-30.pdf]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Cc: Mike Chen <mike.chen@auditops.com>
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 13:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG-Lite: SDLC chronology + ephemeral credential rotation evidence

Priya / Irene — I pulled the first set of artifacts and uploaded a zip with a manifest to the shared drive. Key highlights below and sample filenames (attached in the Drive link in the manifest):

Summary highlights:
- CI runs: exported Jenkins/runner job events for deploy pipelines between 2026-02-01 and 2026-08-29. Each row includes build_id, pipeline_name, git_sha, triggered_by, and approval_flag. (files: ci-run-logs-2026-02-01_to_2026-08-29.csv)
- PR reviews: consolidated approvals for production deploys; includes approver, timestamp, PR number, linked commit (pr-review-export-2026-08.json)
- Emergency patch chronology: one emergency patch event on 2026-05-14 — included the JIRA incident id, runbook snippet used, approval emails, and rollback test evidence (files: emergency-patch-20260514.md, rollback-test-20260515.log)
- KMS/key history: export of key versions and rotation timestamps for service keys used in the private deployment (kms-rotation-log.csv). Keys are referenced by id; secret values have been omitted.
- Ephemeral token sampling: We extracted token issuance/expiry events for five sampled CI runners between 2026-06-01 and 2026-08-01. Tokens are redacted at the token-id level (token-*). File: ephemeral-token-audit-sample-2026-06-08.csv

Attachments we pushed to Drive (manifest references these filenames):
- evidence_manifest_v1.csv
- ci-run-logs-2026-02-01_to_2026-08-29.csv
- pr-review-export-2026-08.json
- kms-rotation-log.csv
- emergency-patch-20260514.md
- rollback-test-20260515.log
- ephemeral-token-audit-sample-2026-06-08.csv
- redaction-readme.txt (explains redaction rules)

Notes on redaction: we removed secret material and redacted token values; key ids remain. The assessor will still be able to validate rotation timestamps, who initiated rotations, and the sequence of events. If they require key material for escrow/inspection, we will follow the contractual process for secure transfer.

I uploaded the zip: ci-run-logs-2026-08.zip to the shared path and included the manifest CSV. Link: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/SDLC-Evidence/nbf-2026/ci-run-logs-2026-08.zip

Marissa Cole
Director, Technical Compliance
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: evidence_manifest_v1.csv; uploaded to Drive]

From: Mike Chen <mike.chen@auditops.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Cc: AuditOps SOC Team <soc@auditops.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG-Lite: SDLC chronology + ephemeral credential rotation evidence

Thanks — this is helpful and much of it looks to be in the format we need. A couple quick follow ups before we schedule a short evidence review:

1) For the ephemeral token sampling CSV could you replace the token-id values with deterministic pseudonyms (you can keep token-1, token-2 etc) and leave the issuance/expiry/event timestamps intact (we still need to verify rotation cadence).
2) For the emergency-patch runbook excerpt, could you include the approval email thread (redact any internal-only troubleshooting logs if needed) — we need to see the approval chain and the timing relative to the deploy event.

If you can push the updated CSV and runbook excerpt by EOD Monday (2026-08-31 23:59 UTC) we'll aim to do a 30-minute evidence review on Tue morning PT. Otherwise propose the next earliest slot.

Best,
Mike
AuditOps
